findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 1 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 25 questions numbered 1-25; by section: 1.1 2, 1.2 1, 1.3 1, 1.4 1, 1.5 2, 1.6 1, 1.7.1 1, 1.7.2 1, 1.7.3 4, 1.7.4 3, 1.7.6 1, 1.7.8 1, 1.8.2 1, 1.9.1 1, 1.9.2 1, 1.9 1, 1.10 2.

Theory parts cover the history of classification, the modern table, metals/non-metals/metalloids, blocks, families, configuration and position, atomic and ionic radius, ionization energy (definitions and the N/O case), electron affinity, electronegativity, metallic character, Na and Mg with oxygen, oxides, chlorides, bonding trends and oxidation numbers; numericals (ionization energy, electron affinity, oxidation numbers) use changed amounts with the chapter's own values, recomputed in Python. None repeats exercise Q.3-Q.6. Book corrections followed (balanced Na₂O₂, MgO(s), Mg + steam and P₂O₃ + water equations; N = 1s² 2s² 2p³, O = 1s² 2s² 2p⁴ with O first IE about 1314 kJ mol⁻¹; S in SCl₂ = +2); the printed P₂O₃ + NaOH equation is not used.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
